title: Enterprise Multi-Agent Production Platform & Tool Sandbox Selection Guide: Azure AI Agent Service (Foundry) vs. LangGraph Platform vs. SK/AutoGen on AKS

workload_basis.task_profile: Planner + SQL Analyst + Python Sandbox Coder + Security Verifier + Synthesizer

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Stateless In-Memory GroupChat Broadcast (Full Transcript Shared Across All 5 Agents)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern in production: 11.8x token amplification and alternating system prompts thrash KV cache

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Stateful Graph (LangGraph + Postgres Checkpointer) Behind Round-Robin K8s Ingress
tiers.recommended_scenario: Solves state persistence and human-in-the-loop pause, but misses per-agent GPU KV affinity

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Turnkey Azure AI Agent Service (Foundry Managed Threads + Entra OBO + ACA Dynamic Sessions)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Best fit for enterprise M365/Fabric/Logic Apps automation requiring zero-ops Hyper-V code sandboxes

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Structured Artifact Handoff Graph + Per-Agent Role Sticky GIE KV Routing + Durable Replay
tiers.recommended_scenario: High-scale enterprise multi-agent standard cutting token consumption by 86.7% and cost by 79.8%
